_comment: ADR 0044 — common physics body templates. Per-game entity defs can spread these via $extends to get sensible defaults. Override individual fields after the $extends to customize. Bits 1..16 from @lib.physics.layers used here; games with custom layer names can override collision_layer / collision_mask.

static_decoration_no_collision._comment: For visible-but-non-blocking decoration. No body = no physics overhead. Use this template by NOT declaring a physics block on the entity.

_authoring_note: Templates use $extends syntax: "physics": {"$extends": "@lib.physics.bodies.standard_kinematic_npc"}. Override individual fields by listing them after the $extends key — last-writer-wins per ADR 0027. Example: bigger wolf needs height: 1.0 → {"$extends": "@lib.physics.bodies.standard_kinematic_animal", "collision_shape": {"type": "capsule", "radius": 0.5, "height": 1.0}}.
